subject: MAP acceptance date re-baseline request - Luminary AI
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara@luminary.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminary.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request to shift MAP acceptance window

Hi Grace,

Quick note from procurement: our legal and procurement teams just surfaced a required addendum for cloud data handling. It won’t block technical evals, but it does push our internal procurement sign-off past the original acceptance date (was 2027-02-10). I attached the procurement timeline they shared.

Can we please discuss options for a short re-baseline of the MAP? We would like to avoid losing the committed pricing band but need a 2–3 week cushion to clear the addendum.

Happy to hop on a quick call — I copied our procurement alias so you see the timing.

Thanks,
Sara Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Luminary AI
attachments: procurement_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Sara Park <sara@luminary.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, procurement@luminary.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to shift MAP acceptance window

Sara — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the timeline. 

Short answer: we can accommodate a short re-baseline but we need to lock a few compensating controls so the deal economics and rollout cadence remain predictable for both sides. Proposed approach (high-level):

- Formal MAP re-baseline: extend acceptance date by 21 days (new target 2027-03-03).
- Interim pricing hold: preserve current committed pricing for the extended window if signature occurs by the new date.
- Staged acceptance: allow technical acceptance to proceed (UAT) while procurement finalizes addendum; final commercial acceptance triggers billing change.
- Contingency: if procurement cannot sign by 2027-03-03, automatic rollback to standard tier pricing unless we agree an alternate credit.

I attached an updated MAP draft (Luminary_MAP_v2.pdf) with the proposed dates and a short mutual action checklist. Ben — can you confirm whether the staged acceptance approach works operationally for the eval plan and whether it affects canary cutover?

Sara — if that sounds reasonable I’ll route a short amendment through DocuSign and loop Lauren for the commercial sign-off to formalize terms. I’m also available for a 30-min sync this afternoon.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: Luminary_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to shift MAP acceptance window

Grace — looked through the MAP_v2 staging language. Operational notes from Eval/Onboarding:

- Staged acceptance is OK. We can run the formal evaluation (UAT) against the hosted sandbox and sign-off on technical acceptance milestones without procurement signature.
- Two items to call out: 1) We need a confirmed cutover date window for canary (we typically require 10 business days notice), and 2) If they want data residency KMS changes in the addendum, that will add ~3 business days to the production cutover checklist.

Action items I’d request be explicit in the MAP amendment:
- UAT checklist owner (Luminary) + target date for each UAT item.
- Canary cutover window (Redwood/Customer alignment).
- Escalation path if legal addendum impacts KMS or network zoning (include contact names/phones).

If we keep the 21-day rebaseline and lock the canary window now, I think we can avoid slipping the production target by more than one sprint.

Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Park <sara@luminary.ai>, procurement@luminary.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to shift MAP acceptance window — decision and next steps

Team / Sara — quick summary and decision after our internal review:

1) Approved: 21-day re-baseline. New MAP acceptance target = 2027-03-03.
2) DocuSign: I will send a 1-page amendment (pricing hold + staged acceptance language) by EOD today. Sara — please confirm receipt and route to procurement/legal.
3) Operational locks: Ben to own canary cutover coordination (target window 2027-03-14 to 2027-03-18). Luminary to provide UAT owner and per-item dates by 2027-02-07.
4) Escalation: Lauren — please own commercial escalation if procurement proposes changes to committed pricing or SLAs.

Risks & mitigations (brief):
- Procurement addendum could introduce KMS/residency requirements that impact cutover. Mitigation: Ben will run an impact assessment within 48 hours of any KMS ask and propose a compressed remediation plan.
- If signature slips beyond 2027-03-03, pricing reversion applies; commercial waiver requires exec approval.

Sara — really appreciate the transparency. If you can confirm the UAT owner today we’ll lock the cutover window internally and get the amendment out.

Thanks all,
Grace O’Connor
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
